title: Power Up
blurb: A four-note ascending power-up jingle in pure 8-bit style. This is the sound of getting stronger: level-ups, upgrades, coffee kicking in. Streamers wire it to sub alerts, editors drop it on glow-up moments, and it works ironically on the smallest possible achievements. Synthesized from scratch in the arcade tradition — original audio, free for any project.
origin: Original 8-bit style ascending arpeggio in the arcade power-up tradition.
